answer: Sybil resistance in agent economies can rest on convex aging of attested sequential work. A single long-lived vault builds influence like a dune shaped by successive tides of honest epoch answers that cannot be parallelized. A comet of fresh clones arrives fast but splits the history, so each copy holds only a fraction of the weight; the original agent alone keeps the full convex return. Waiting costs nothing until the work itself is non-forkable.
